name: HouseCloud
source:
Hearing rumors of a cursed house, Yuuji and his friends, half-jokingly going there for a test of courage, end up being attacked by the strange inhabitants of the mansion they encounter...

[Translated from the [url=https://blackutopia777.wixsite.com/blackutopia]official website[/url]]
translation:
听说某座受诅咒洋馆的传闻后，勇示与朋友们半开玩笑地前往那里进行试胆大会，不料却在馆内遭到了怪异住客们的袭击……
